verdict.rationale: GitHub's Copilot docs directly claim the product can "Automatically select the best model for each task," which matches the story exactly. Related docs confirm that Copilot offers multiple models with different strengths, so there is a pool for it to select from. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how auto model selection works (which surfaces/IDEs, selection criteria, interaction with premium request limits), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the tool automatically pick the best model for each task

citations.quote: Automatically select the best model for each task.
GitHub Copilot supports multiple AI models, each with different strengths.
